description_en: Asynchronously generates an image from text
description_zh: 根据文字异步生成图片
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi generate-image-task --agent-key e1be065b-adc3-435e-bd01-1c18c5ed75d3 --paragraph-list TaskId=e1be065b-adc3-435e-bd01-1c18c5ed75d3 Content=一直忧伤的猫 Id=1 TaskStatus=SUCCESSED --style auto --size 102401024 --article-task-id e1be065b-adc3-435e-bd01-1c18c5ed75d3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateImageTask

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587494.html
parameters.name: agent_key

element_fields.help_en:
The unique ID of the task.

By default, you do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically generates a task ID. If you specify the same TaskId for subsequent tasks, these tasks are considered part of the same conversation group
element_fields.help_zh:
任务唯一标识
TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话
element_fields.name: task_id

element_fields.help_en:
The current status of the task.

PENDING: The task is in the queue.

RUNNING: The task is in progress.

SUSPENDED: The task is suspended.

SUCCEEDED: The task was successful.

FAILED: The task failed.

UNKNOWN: The task does not exist or its status is unknown
element_fields.help_zh:
当前任务状态 

PENDING：任务排队中
RUNNING：任务处理中
SUSPENDED：任务挂起
SUCCEEDED：任务执行成功
FAILED：任务执行失败
UNKNOWN：任务不存在或状态未知
element_fields.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: The size of the image to generate
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The task ID of the article. If you do not have one, you can assign a universally unique identifier (UUID)
parameters.help_zh: 文章taskId，如目前没有，可以赋值为UUID
parameters.name: article_task_id
